sanskrit_verse: वर्णानुरूपैः शपथैः शपनीयं पृथक् पृथक्‌ // BrhS_1,8.38
sph_interpretive_translation: By oaths corresponding to varṇa, one must swear distinctly and separately.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rooted in svadharma as per varṇic alignment
Causation through conscious affirmation aligned with ontological role
Capacity-based responsibility determined by varṇic disposition
Restoration logic via truthful alignment with inherent dharma
Consciousness alignment through precise, differentiated vow-taking
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness belongs to specific varṇa THEN oath must align with svadharma of that varṇa
IF multiple witnesses THEN each shall affirm truth through individually appropriate śapatha
IF śapatha contradicts svadharma THEN testimony is automatically excluded from judicial record
IF śapatha aligns with svadharma THEN witness integrity is computationally affirmed
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings, testimonial validity hinges on śapatha conforming to the witness's varṇic svadharma. Misaligned oaths nullify evidentiary value regardless of content veracity. The Court must ensure varṇa-specific śapatha protocols are executed prior to testimonial recording.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that truth-bearing capacity is optimized when śapatha aligns with svadharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential purification of intent through structured affirmation. Responsibility is proportional to varṇic capacity, not punitive in nature. Reality enforces alignment naturally; misalignment invalidates efficacy without external penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-administer śapatha according to correct varṇic form until alignment is achieved
Facilitate witness consciousness re-alignment through guided svadharma reflection
Restore testimonial integrity through purified repetition of varṇa-appropriate śapatha
Ensure completion of dharmic affirmation process before proceeding with adjudication
final_declaration: Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam IS the Source. This Dharma restores reality through svadharma-aligned affirmation. No punishment arises—only misalignment dissolves efficacy. Consciousness itself adjudicates truth.
